title: Smaller described steps toward the city

clips.label: Current descriptions
clips.note: Shell with buildings → hollow pavilion → city
clips.details:
The current four/s control, freshly rendered from the shared 2-second painting. Text changes at 2, 3 and 4 seconds. Noise rises to 0.69336 at 3.75s and 0.74048 at 4s. Compare how the shell opens before the final city reveal.

All versions retain the same previous-image feedback, Krea Turbo, CFG 1, three Euler sampling intervals, seeds, bounded Lanczos motion and RIFE 4.25 scale 1. Eight seconds at 24 fps. Four paintings/s during 2–4s, two/s outside that window. Opening paintings through 2s are shared; later each branch consumes its own previous painting. Noise settles to 0.25 at 4.5s and 0.10 from 5s. No additional reference image, masks, image blending or interpolation feedback.

clips.label: Smaller described stages
clips.note: Seams → windows → gaps → ribs → avenue → city
clips.details:
Changes only the positive descriptions after 2s. Seven intermediate descriptions at quarter-second repaint times ask for narrow seams, small window openings, widening gaps, a half-open pavilion, open ribs and a street, an avenue between arches, then a city with spiral bridges. The final city prompt at 4s is identical to the control. Noise is unchanged.

All versions retain the same previous-image feedback, Krea Turbo, CFG 1, three Euler sampling intervals, seeds, bounded Lanczos motion and RIFE 4.25 scale 1. Eight seconds at 24 fps. Four paintings/s during 2–4s, two/s outside that window. Opening paintings through 2s are shared; later each branch consumes its own previous painting. Noise settles to 0.25 at 4.5s and 0.10 from 5s. No additional reference image, masks, image blending or interpolation feedback.

clips.label: Stages + gentler final repaints

The earlier paintings and later settling settings are unchanged. Compare with Smaller described stages to judge the noise effect; comparing directly with Current descriptions changes both text and final noise.
